scenarios.name: Image → Landmark → Nearby recommendations
scenarios.input: Photo of Qutub Minar (image file: img_3287_img378.jpg)
scenarios.expected: Identify Qutub Minar, New Delhi with >95% confidence and recommend nearby attractions (Iron Pillar, Mehrauli, Alai Darwaza).

scenarios.notes: Direct verification of user audit constraint: eliminates forced tourist city detours on long highway routes.
